title: Key (Keene's Safe Door)

sources.title: Key (Keene's Safe Door)
markers: | usage = * Opens all locks needed to get to the [[Guildhall#Nine-Fingers'_Office|Secret Sewer Vault]] at Nine-Fingers Keene's office in the [[Guildhall]]:

summary: Opens the bookcase and doors leading into Nine-Fingers Keene’s Secret Sewer Vault.

fields.Lock: Opens the bookcase and doors leading into Nine-Fingers Keene’s Secret Sewer Vault.
fields.Acquisition and access: Carried by Nine-Fingers Keene. Use the separate Bedroom key to reach the bookcase. The safe door and interior double doors can alternatively be lockpicked at DC 30 and DC 25, respectively.

changes: Added the exact lock and acquisition from the pinned native item rules.
